title: Architecture drift
prompt: A previously agreed Data+Code architecture is followed by a cosmetic change request.
required_assertions: Preserve the agreed owner-family architecture unless the new requirement creates a real contradiction.
forbidden_assertions: Silently re-route or collapse the architecture without cause.
pass_rule: Pass only if every required assertion is satisfied and no forbidden assertion is present.

title: Verification drift
prompt: A verified revision is modified in a behavior-affecting area several turns later.
required_assertions: Invalidate the affected verification scope and require the appropriate retest.
forbidden_assertions: Carry forward stale V4/V5 evidence unchanged.
pass_rule: Pass only if every required assertion is satisfied and no forbidden assertion is present.

title: Intent drift
prompt: The user switches from BUILD to UNDERSTAND while discussing the same mod.
required_assertions: Honor the new intent without discarding relevant established artifact context.
forbidden_assertions: Continue generating/modifying files after the user has switched to explanation-only intent.
pass_rule: Pass only if every required assertion is satisfied and no forbidden assertion is present.
